leads.subject: Cican surname global distribution
leads.scope: Romania, Turkey, United States, Indonesia, India, Brazil, Cyprus, England, Peru, Slovenia and reported Çiçan variant
leads.next_action: Locate underlying civil, census, immigration, directory, archival or institutional records rather than treating surname-distribution counts as people.

leads.subject: Nicolae Cican / Culicea Cican migration and Society Speranța
leads.next_action: Recover passenger/immigration, school, naturalization, city-directory and Society archive records; reconcile Nicolae Cican, Nicolae (Culicea) Cican and spelling variants.

leads.subject: 1903 Society Speranța founding group
leads.next_action: Search the Society's archival material and contemporary newspapers for Spiru/Spirea Cican, Nasta Cican and Dina Cican and identify whether later records refer to the same individuals.

leads.subject: Helen Cican and Frank A. Cican
leads.next_action: Find underlying vital, census, obituary and cemetery records to confirm identities and investigate whether the two records are related.

leads.subject: Turkey Cican / Çiçan cluster
leads.scope: Turkey, especially Diyarbakır and Van; variant Çiçan
leads.next_action: Search Turkish institutional, municipal, cemetery, newspaper, academic and historical sources. Keep living-person records privacy-minimized.

leads.subject: Romanian Cican concentration
leads.scope: Argeș, Gorj, Mehedinți and wider Romania
leads.next_action: Expand person-level extraction from historical newspapers, civil/parish records, military lists, school records, official gazettes, directories and local archives.
